products.name: Lumen Silk Slip Dress
products.tagline: Bias-cut mulberry silk with a barely-there strap.
products.description: Cut on the bias from 19-momme mulberry silk, the Lumen slip falls in a single unbroken line from a scooped neck to a mid-calf hem. Designed to be worn alone or under a coat, it is the house's most requested evening piece.
products.details: Mid-calf length. Adjustable spaghetti straps. Invisible side zip. Fully lined in silk habotai. Made in a limited atelier run.
products.materials: 19-momme mulberry silk. Silk habotai lining. Mother-of-pearl adjusters.
products.care: Dry clean only. Store hanging, away from direct light. Steam, never iron.

products.name: Marlowe Linen Midi Dress
products.tagline: A square neck and a skirt that moves in heat.
products.description: European flax linen, washed until it feels like a well-loved shirt. The Marlowe has a square neck, cap sleeves, and a softly gathered midi skirt. It is the dress you pack first.
products.details: Midi length. Side-seam pockets. Back keyhole with covered button. Unlined.
products.care: Cold machine wash. Hang dry. Embrace the crease.

products.name: Solace Column Dress
products.tagline: A straight line from clavicle to ankle.
products.description: Heavy crepe that holds a column without stiffness. The Solace dress is sleeveless, with a jewel neck and a slit that starts just above the knee. Evening, without costume.
products.details: Ankle length. Back zip. Lined. Internal stay tape at the neck.
products.care: Dry clean. Hang immediately after wearing.

products.name: Riviera Wrap Dress
products.tagline: A true wrap, not a faux one.
products.description: The Riviera ties at the waist and can be worn as loose or as close as you like. Printed in a rust botanical drawn from an archive textile in the Abeera library.
products.details: True wrap with interior tie. Three-quarter sleeve. Midi hem.
products.care: Dry clean recommended. Cool iron on reverse.

products.name: Cloud Cotton Shirt
products.tagline: The white shirt, finally finished.
products.description: Egyptian cotton poplin with a hidden placket, a slightly elongated cuff, and a hem that tucks without bulk. The Cloud shirt is the house staple.
products.details: Regular fit. Mother-of-pearl buttons. Single chest pocket, optional to remove.
products.care: Machine wash cold. Iron damp for a crisp finish, or wear rumpled.

products.name: Arden Silk Blouse
products.tagline: A collar that sits. A sleeve that pours.
products.description: The Arden blouse is cut from fluid silk with a covered placket and a collar designed to stand without starch. Champagne in daylight, gold at night.
products.details: Relaxed fit. Covered buttons. French seams.
products.care: Dry clean. Steam from the reverse.

products.name: North Knit Tank
products.tagline: Fine merino, no itch, no cling.
products.description: A fine-gauge merino tank with a bound neck and enough weight to sit, not cling. Layer under the Harbor coat or wear alone in late heat.
products.details: Slim fit. Bound neck and armholes. Hip length.
products.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat.

products.name: Field Poplin Shirt
products.tagline: A stripe that was drawn, not printed.
products.description: Yarn-dyed stripe on compact poplin. The Field shirt has a camp collar and a slightly cropped, untucked hem — weekend architecture.
products.details: Relaxed. Camp collar. Chest pocket. Straight hem.
products.care: Machine wash cold. Hang dry.

products.name: Atelier Wool Trouser
products.tagline: A high rise and a break that was measured twice.
products.description: Super 120s wool with a crease that holds. The Atelier trouser has a high rise, a full length, and a side zip so the front stays uninterrupted.
products.details: High rise. Full length. Side zip. Internal waist stay.
products.care: Dry clean. Hang with clips at the hem overnight.

products.name: Coast Wide-Leg Linen
products.tagline: Air, then structure.
products.description: Washed linen with a wide leg and a paper-bag waist that can be worn tied or tucked. The Coast pant is for heat, travel, and stone floors.
products.details: High rise. Wide leg. Side pockets. Tie waist.
products.care: Cold wash. Hang dry.

products.name: Studio Straight Denim
products.tagline: Indigo that fades like a well-kept secret.
products.description: Japanese selvedge denim, rinsed once. A straight leg, a mid rise, and hardware in antique brass. The Studio jean is meant to be worn in, not distressed for you.
products.details: Mid rise. Straight leg. Five pocket. Selvedge outseam.
products.care: Wash inside out, cold, as rarely as you can bear.

products.name: Meridian Knit Skirt
products.tagline: A rib that elongates.
products.description: Fine rib merino, midi length, with a hidden elastic that does not bulge. The Meridian skirt is the knit equivalent of a good trouser.
products.details: Midi. Pull-on. Split at the back hem.
products.care: Hand wash. Dry flat.

products.name: Harbor Wool Coat
products.tagline: Camel, unapologetic.
products.description: Double-faced wool with a notched lapel, a concealed placket, and a weight that makes weather irrelevant. The Harbor coat is the one people remember.
products.details: Knee length. Concealed buttons. Two welt pockets. Half-lined.
products.care: Dry clean twice a season, no more. Brush after rain.

products.name: Night Trench
products.tagline: A trench without costume.
products.description: Cotton gabardine in stone, with a storm flap that actually sheds water and a belt that sits at the true waist. The Night trench is for cities that surprise you with rain.
products.details: Midi. Storm flap. Gun flap. Belted. Raglan sleeve.
products.care: Sponge clean. Dry clean annually.

products.name: Alpine Cashmere Cardigan
products.tagline: A cardigan with a shoulder.
products.description: Grade-A cashmere, fully fashioned, with a slightly boxy body and a rib that holds. The Alpine cardigan replaces a jacket on travel days.
products.details: Boxy. Five-button. Patch pockets. Hip length.
products.care: Hand wash or dry clean. Store folded with cedar.

products.name: Trace Leather Jacket
products.tagline: Lambskin, not costume biker.
products.description: Vegetable-tanned lambskin with a clean zip, a standing collar, and a lining in cupro. The Trace jacket is the leather piece that does not announce itself.
products.details: Hip length. Two-way zip. Welt pockets. Unstructured shoulder.
products.care: Condition twice a year. Keep away from heat.

products.name: Oval Gold Hoops
products.tagline: A hoop that is almost an oval.
products.description: Recycled 18k gold vermeil on a sculptural oval. Light enough for every day, large enough to catch late light.
products.details: 45mm. Hinged closure. Sold as a pair.
products.care: Wipe with a soft cloth. Avoid perfume on the metal.

products.name: Soft Structured Tote
products.tagline: Holds a day without looking like luggage.
products.description: Vegetable-tanned leather with a slouch that is engineered, not accidental. The tote fits a 13-inch laptop, a knit, and the book you will actually read.
products.details: Unlined. Magnetic closure. Interior slip pocket. Detachable strap.
products.care: Condition with a neutral cream. Rain spots fade with time.

products.name: Sculptural Heel
products.tagline: A 70mm heel you can actually walk in.
products.description: Nappa leather with a sculpted almond toe and a 70mm heel that sits under the arch, not behind it. The house shoe for dinners that become walks.
products.details: 70mm heel. Leather sole. Padded insole. Made in Italy.
products.materials: Nappa leather. Leather lining and sole.
products.care: Use trees. Polish with a cream, not a liquid.

products.name: Atelier Silk Scarf
products.tagline: A square from the archive.
products.description: A 90cm silk twill square printed with a drawing from the Abeera textile library — stone, ink, and a single gold line.
products.details: 90 × 90 cm. Hand-rolled hem.
products.care: Dry clean. Store rolled, not folded.

products.name: Thin Leather Belt
products.tagline: 20 millimetres of chocolate leather.
products.description: A thin belt that belongs on the Atelier trouser or over the Marlowe dress. Brass buckle, unlacquered, meant to dull.
products.details: 20mm width. Adjustable. Unlacquered brass.
products.care: The brass will tarnish. Let it.

products.name: Pearl Drop Earrings
products.tagline: One pearl, slightly baroque.
products.description: Freshwater pearls, unmatched on purpose, suspended from a gold vermeil hook. For evenings when the dress is already doing the work.
products.details: Drop 4cm. Sold as a pair.
products.care: Keep pearls away from perfume. Wipe after wearing.

products.name: Night Acetate Sunglasses
products.tagline: A frame with a quiet lens.
products.description: Italian acetate in deep stone, with grey-green lenses that do not shout. The Night sunglass is the only pair you need to pack.
products.details: Category 3 lens. UV400. Includes case and cloth.
products.care: Rinse with water, never paper.

products.name: The Sunday Sweater
products.tagline: A crewneck with time in it.
products.description: Heavy merino-cashmere with a dropped shoulder and a rib that does not flare. The Sunday sweater is for travel, desks, and late breakfasts.
products.details: Relaxed. Crew neck. Rib hem and cuff.
products.care: Hand wash. Dry flat.

products.name: Cropped Tailored Jacket
products.tagline: A jacket that ends where the waist begins.
products.description: A cropped, darted jacket in tropical wool. Wear it with the Coast linen or the Studio denim — it is the piece that makes weekend look considered.
products.details: Cropped. Two-button. Flap pockets. Fully lined.
products.care: Dry clean. Hang on a shaped hanger.

products.name: Last Season Blazer
products.tagline: The previous cut, still right.
products.description: A longer blazer from last autumn's atelier, in remaining sizes. Same cloth, a slightly longer body. Not a lesser piece — a last look.
products.details: Regular length. Two-button. Ticket pocket.
products.care: Dry clean.

products.name: Fine Cotton Tank
products.tagline: A layering tank, now at a quieter price.
products.description: Supima cotton jersey with a bound neck. Intended as a layer; often worn alone. Remaining colours from the winter run.
products.details: Slim. Bound neck. Hip length.
products.care: Machine wash cold.

products.name: Pleated Midi Skirt
products.tagline: Pleats that remember.
products.description: Heat-set pleats in a fluid viscose that returns after sitting. The midi skirt for days that begin at a desk and end somewhere with a stone floor.
products.details: Midi. Side zip. Partial lining.
products.care: Hang after washing. Do not crush.

products.name: Cashmere Beanie
products.tagline: A beanie that does not look like a beanie.
products.description: Fine-rib cashmere, no cuff fold, no logo. For travel days and the first cold morning.
products.details: Fine rib. Uncuffed. One size with give.
products.care: Hand wash. Dry flat.
